description: Portable patterns from claw-code-parity Rust implementation to enhance the Global Agent Registry (GHARRA)

patterns.name: Plugin Manifest → Agent Registration
patterns.source_pattern: PluginManifest struct with metadata (name, version, description, kind, permissions, hooks, lifecycle commands, tools)
patterns.adaptation: Map plugin.json manifest schema to Agent Card schema — name, capabilities, endpoints, crypto material, transport config. Use InstalledPluginRegistry pattern for persistent agent registry with validation-on-write.

patterns.name: MCP Discovery → Agent Discovery
patterns.source_pattern: McpConfigCollection with content-hash signatures, normalized naming (mcp__<server>__<tool>), scoped configs (User/Project/Local)
patterns.adaptation: Map MCP server discovery to agent discovery endpoints. Agents register with transport configs (stdio/SSE/HTTP/WS). Registry normalizes identifiers and returns cache signatures.

patterns.name: Permission System → Zero-Trust Verification
patterns.source_pattern: Three-mode PermissionPolicy (ReadOnly/WorkspaceWrite/DangerFullAccess) with deny→hook-override→allow→ask→escalation flow. Wildcard and prefix matching on extracted subjects.
patterns.adaptation: Map to ABAC 9-rule categories. Flow becomes deny→trust-verification→allow→break-glass-escalation. Hook overrides map to trust anchor verification callbacks.

patterns.name: Layered Config → Federated Trust Policies
patterns.source_pattern: RuntimeConfig with 3-layer merge (User < Project < Local). ConfigSource enum scopes entries. Deep merge semantics for overlapping keys.
patterns.adaptation: Map to Root < Sovereign < Organizational registry layers. Sovereign overrides Root within jurisdiction. Organizational cannot weaken Sovereign deny rules.
